command: python3 -c "import os,glob,zipfile,sys; L=open('pubspec.yaml').read().splitlines(); name=next((x.split(':',1)[1].strip() for x in L if x.startswith('name:')),None); version=next((x.split(':',1)[1].strip() for x in L if x.startswith('version:')),None); print('pubspec:', name or 'NO NAME', version or 'NO VERSION'); errs=[]; errs+=['pubspec has no name'] if not name else []; errs+=['pubspec has no version'] if not version else []; errs+=['lib/ missing'] if not os.path.isdir('lib') else []; a=glob.glob('android/libs/*.aar'); errs+=['no android aar'] if not a else []; errs+=[x+' invalid aar' for x in a if (not zipfile.is_zipfile(x) or 'classes.jar' not in zipfile.ZipFile(x).namelist())]; xf=glob.glob('ios/Frameworks/*.xcframework'); errs+=['no ios xcframework'] if not xf else []; print('android aar:', a or 'none'); print('ios xcframework:', xf or 'none'); print('FAIL: '+'; '.join(errs)) if errs else print('PASS: pubspec+lib+artifacts valid'); sys.exit(1 if errs else 0)"
